source: DIE-HBM-97 KVPIPE rev3 2026-11-10: the per-bank-column copies g_col[c] (h128 / wf4 / fill / in_v, ~20 cells, ~4.2 um2 each) of ot_hbm_sm_kv_line; copy c feeds banks c and c+4 (bank k at x-column k%4) and bb / sc / lane slices of column c.  One small GPL guide pad per column, 60 x 10.8 um centred on the column just above the upper bank row (top 172.84).  Pads must stay small: GPL removes an INCLUSIVE region's area from the top-level region, and full-strip boxes (rev3 v1, 726 x 55 um) left the top level at 280 % utilisation (GPL-0301, vE probe 11-10).  Picked up by gen_core_kit_hbm.py (default_reg_guides) when no --reg-guide-boxes / --macro-reg-guide is given; released before DPL.
